_comment: Page copy for where-your-money-goes.html. Edited through the CMS at /admin. tools/build-pages.js writes these values back into the HTML at deploy time, so the text stays crawlable.
hero__p-1:
What we spend, who decides, and the documents to check us
      against. If something here is not yet posted, it says so.
1-allocation__p-1: Expenses split three ways, straight from our Form 990.
2-documents__p-1:
What we have is here to download. What we do not have yet is listed anyway,
        marked clearly, so you can see the whole picture.
3-leadership__p-1:
Our board governs the foundation. Our staff and key volunteers run it
        day to day.
cta__p-1: We would rather answer a hard question than lose your trust.
